status.stage: unapproved prototype derivative (convention cosplay costumes of the ordinary zombie); art / fit / deformation not certified
status.licenseClearance: none - prototype status as every Meshy-generated asset of this repository; the head pieces inherit their source models' status (community-supplied mascot / sushi figurine sources via the user, no licence or authorship claim)

item: Full convention cosplay costumes for the ordinary zombie (Skyways anime convention): head piece + upper + lower with legwear and footwear, fitted per body
generation: no generation by this builder (no network / Meshy / Codex / inference): the garment masters are the primary's Meshy T2.5 image-to-3D outputs of Codex INITIAL ghost-mannequin concepts (task studio-cosplay-general-20261108-225231-01, fresh user Meshy authority; private, immutable, sha256-pinned); the head pieces are split from approved repository models (build-cosplay.mjs)

honesty.fitting: CPU landmark retarget + offset-field clearance through every validation pose (lib/costume-fit.mjs); no cloth simulation
honesty.texture: Meshy base colour / normal / roughness / metallic maps resized and re-encoded / packed only (no retexture, no painting, no projection)
honesty.heads: rigid head pieces from the convention mascot / sushi figurine (their maps kept; the rose palette a per-texel colour transform of the mascot map, as build-cosplay.mjs)

method: garments: degenerate triangles dropped; meshoptimizer UV-weighted simplification to the runtime budget (one shared topology / UVs / indices for every body); interior caps (Meshy's closed openings, skirt floors, skirt-lining bridges to the legwear, chords through a limb) found over every body the piece is tried on and dropped

parts (garment frame): upper = torso + sleeves (measured armpits, the seam leaning out along the sleeve angle); lower = waist / skirt + legs (trousers below the measured crotch; skirt legwear below the measured hem and up under it) + footwear (below the configured shoe top)

retarget: torso / waist one scale per axis from the reference section to the body's + ease, back / centre per height, vertical landmarks (armpit, shoulder line, configured hem / waist, crotch); sleeves along shoulder -> elbow -> wrist -> hand (configured cuff); trouser legs along hip -> knee -> ankle; tight legwear on the leg's smoothed outer surface + 3.5 mm; shoes heel / toe / sole / width boxes onto the foot, turned to its yaw, the body's own feet hidden inside

clearance: an offset field on the inner surface (the closed skin + fused hair, never free hair; + the fitted lower under an upper): every cloth vertex >= 6-7 mm outside its anchor, every covered skin vertex >= 4-5 mm under cloth, then the same through every validation pose (lib/fit07.mjs method); chords / contacts it cannot clear are reported, not chased

weights: the body's own skin weights at the anchor; collars / hoods follow the neck; skirts and hems below the crotch follow the thighs (the centre line split between both); masked smoothing; quantised to u8

masks: body triangles enclosed by the cloth in the bind pose (normal + 4 tilted rays) and covered in every validation pose are hidden; the feet inside the shoes are hidden; the upper hides the lower's waist it encloses (hideWear)

head pieces: build-cosplay.mjs's split of the mascot statue / sushi figurine and its rigid fits, here re-run for every costume body; the bear-ear hat carries its wig only on short-haired bodies (the long-haired pale bodies wear the hat alone on their own hair, fitted with a wider scale / lift search)
validation: every 0.1 s of all six clips + each clip's last frame; metrics on the shipped u8 weights (lib/costume-metrics.mjs); a (costume, body) ships only when every limit holds in every frame

limitations: Linear-blend skinned with the body's weights: no cloth simulation (skirts swing with the thighs, never drape).
Meshy hidden-side geometry is AI-reconstructed; interior caps it closed openings with are removed, not rebuilt.
Heeled / platform footwear keeps its shape: the body's flat foot is hidden inside (the open arch shows the floor, as a real one).
Long hair hangs over / through the collar and back of a jacket where it lies within the cloth offset.
